description: This file defines React components for a custom context menu UI, utilizing Radix UI primitives and lucide icons, with utility functions for styling and composition.

methods.name: ContextMenu
methods.description: Root component for the context menu, rendering Radix UI's Root component with additional data attribute.

methods.name: ContextMenuTrigger
methods.description: Component that triggers the context menu, wrapping Radix UI's Trigger component.

methods.name: ContextMenuGroup
methods.description: Component for grouping menu items, wrapping Radix UI's Group component.

methods.name: ContextMenuPortal
methods.description: Component for portal rendering of menu content, wrapping Radix UI's Portal component.

methods.name: ContextMenuSub
methods.description: Component for submenu, wrapping Radix UI's Sub component.

methods.name: ContextMenuRadioGroup
methods.description: Component for radio button group within menu, wrapping Radix UI's RadioGroup.

methods.name: ContextMenuSubTrigger
methods.description: Component for submenu trigger with styling and icon, wrapping Radix UI's SubTrigger.

methods.name: ContextMenuSubContent
methods.description: Component for submenu content with animation and styling, wrapping Radix UI's SubContent.

methods.name: ContextMenuContent
methods.description: Component for the main menu content with portal and styling, wrapping Radix UI's Content.

methods.name: ContextMenuItem
methods.description: Component for a menu item with styling, supporting variants and inset options.

methods.name: ContextMenuCheckboxItem
methods.description: Component for checkbox menu item with indicator icon.

methods.name: ContextMenuRadioItem
methods.description: Component for radio button menu item with indicator icon.

methods.name: ContextMenuLabel
methods.description: Component for menu labels with optional inset styling.

methods.name: ContextMenuSeparator
methods.description: Component for visual separator in menu.

methods.name: ContextMenuShortcut
methods.description: Component for displaying shortcut hints in menu items.
